title.ko: 가정해 보기: 제2 조건문 (If I had...)

ex.t: Si me tocara la lotería, viajaría.
ex.en: If I won the lottery, I would travel.

ex.t: Si fuera rico, compraría una casa grande.
ex.ko: 내가 부자라면 큰 집을 살 거예요.
ex.en: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.

ex.t: Si tuviera más tiempo, haría ejercicio.
ex.en: If I had more time, I would exercise.
I would travel around the world.

ex.t: Yo en tu lugar iría al médico.
ex.en: If I were you, I would see a doctor.
My dream is to be a writer.
Maybe I would go to Paris.

explain.ko: 가능성이 낮거나 상상 속인 상황은 si + 접속법 불완료과거, 조건법으로 말합니다. 조건법은 동사원형에 -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían을 붙입니다: viajaría, compraría. ser는 fuera, tener는 tuviera입니다. 조언은 'En tu lugar + 조건법'입니다.
explain.en: Imaginary or unlikely situations use si + imperfect subjunctive, conditional. The conditional adds -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían to the infinitive: viajaría, compraría. Ser → fuera, tener → tuviera. Advice: 'En tu lugar + conditional'.

lines.t: ¿Qué harías si te tocara la lotería?

trans.en: (Question) What would you do if you won the lottery?

trans.ko: (질문) 시간이 더 있다면 뭘 할 거예요?
trans.en: (Question) What would you do if you had more time?

lines.t: ¿Qué harías si te tocara la lotería?
Viajaría por todo el mundo. ¿Y tú?
Compraría una casa grande y ayudaría a los pobres.

trans.ko:
A: 복권에 당첨되면 뭘 할래?
B: 세계를 여행할 거야. 너는?
A: 나는 큰 집을 사고 가난한 사람들을 도울 거야.
B: 정말 좋은 생각이야.
trans.en:
A: What would you do if you won the lottery?
B: I would travel around the world. What about you?
A: I would buy a big house and help poor people.
B: That's a really good idea.

lines.t: Mi sueño es ser escritor. Si tuviera más tiempo, escribiría todos los días. Si tuviera más dinero, trabajaría menos y viviría en París. Pero ahora tengo que ir al colegio.

trans.ko: 제 꿈은 작가가 되는 거예요. 시간이 더 있다면 매일 글을 쓸 거예요. 돈이 더 있다면 일을 줄이고 파리에서 살 거예요. 하지만 지금은 학교에 가야 해요.
trans.en: My dream is to be a writer. If I had more time, I would write every day. If I had more money, I would work less and live in Paris. But now I have to go to school.

lines.t: ¿Qué haría si le tocara la lotería?

trans.ko:
직원: 복권에 당첨되면 뭘 하실 거예요?
손님: 큰 집을 살 거예요.
직원: 일은 그만두실 거예요?
손님: 아니요, 그만두지 않을 거예요.
trans.en:
Interviewer: What would you do if you won the lottery?
Guest: I would buy a big house.
Interviewer: Would you quit your job?
Guest: No, I wouldn't quit.

items.passage:
1) Si me ___ la lotería, viajaría.
2) Si ___ rico, compraría una casa grande.
3) Yo en tu lugar ___ al médico.

trans.ko: 1) 복권에 당첨되면 여행할 거예요. 2) 내가 부자라면 큰 집을 살 거예요. 3) 내가 너라면 의사에게 갈 거예요.
trans.en: 1) If I won the lottery, I would travel. 2) If I were rich, I would buy a big house. 3) If I were you, I would see a doctor.

Yo en tu lugar ___ al médico.

items.passage: Mi sueño es ser escritor. Si (1) más tiempo, escribiría todos los días. Si tuviera más dinero, (2) menos y viviría en (3).

trans.ko: 제 꿈은 작가가 되는 거예요. 시간이 더 있다면 매일 글을 쓸 거예요. 돈이 더 있다면 일을 줄이고 파리에서 살 거예요.
trans.en: My dream is to be a writer. If I had more time, I would write every day. If I had more money, I would work less and live in Paris.

items.passage: El sueño de Eva es ser escritora. Si tuviera más tiempo, escribiría todos los días. Le gustaría vivir en París.

trans.ko: 에바의 꿈은 작가가 되는 거예요. 시간이 더 있다면 그녀는 매일 글을 쓸 거예요. 그녀는 파리에서 살고 싶어요.
trans.en: Eva's dream is to be a writer. If she had more time, she would write every day. She would like to live in Paris.
